target: Link dcp_setback_controls.provision_id -> regulatory_provisions.id where a control's quoted source_text matches exactly one provision in that council (scripts/link_controls_to_provisions.py)
findings_summary: Ceiling is 35 of 1,069: 450 controls belong to 14 LGAs with zero provisions, 530 have no provision containing their quote, 23 ambiguous, 31 quote under 30 chars. lga is an lga_registry slug but source_council holds slug OR display_name (16/30 exact), so resolution goes through the registry. Heaviest per-council fetch 0.86s, no batching needed. provision_id has a real FK and nothing consumes it, so no served output can change.
